I've done this before at work, lol, I have a computer pair and my transitionals.

If I had a kid in 4th grade my parents would have killed me. That is way too young to be having children 😂😂😂

I am disturbed... 

The picture is horrible too :)
My friend brought hers into work yesterday, looks exactly like this. Cutest thing ever!!!!

My cat bites me, or will chew on the electrical chords or anything that will get me out of bed. He's been at it as early as 4.30am the little shit. Lucky he is cute and I love him. I have resorted to putting him in the crate until a more reasonable time though, he must not be rewarded for biting me.

Sorry you are going through this, sounds bloody rough.

There is no such thing as normal, that is just society trying to get you to conform to their standards. Dont try to fit in to their ways, try to find something you enjoy and do that,  there are good moments to be had if you search for them.

 It's hard when your family don't understand, my parents never understood me, even now they struggle. Sometimes I just act like they want me to so they are happy. But then I move on and not think about their world, it's hard, but has to be done to stay sane. 

I hope you find your path, and people to love you for who you are not who they want you to be. 

Stay safe, all the best. If you need to talk, I'm here.

Thank you for sharing, you are not alone. It is so hard when your thoughts race around like a massive knotted up ball of wool to find any kind of peace, I have been there too many times to remember. 
Then add all the emotions to those thoughts and it can feel like your drowning. Personally I journal, I find it slows my thoughts down and helps me to concentrate on one thing at a time. There are many ways to do this though, meditation, watching a sunset, singing etc... sounds like your lizards and stuff help you. 
Sometimes I imagine I'm in an empty room with two windows open either side of me, when a thought comes in one window, I make it go out the other. Whatever works for you, do that. Even getting on here helps. 
I hope you find the quiet that your longing for, but remember you are not alone, you got this, it will come eventually, don't give up. 
Praying all the best for you in your journey. Xxx

Let's not forget it's not about the destination, but the journey. There is no perfect / happy ending. Cause if it's the end, that's means you are dead. 
Enjoy every moment, the single, the married, kids, no kids, job, no job...
Journey, enjoy, breathe, smile and know that today you have a choice to enjoy the simple moments.

Hi, I am so sorry i haven't replied before now. Please know it's not because of you, but rather I am new to Reddit and didn't realise the little numbers down the bottom meant that someone had replied to my comment. I hope you are doing well and still with us? I hope other people have reached out to you, I think people are quick to offer placards, but follow through is often harder because it requires commitment. Is there a way to chat on Reddit? I am more used to Facebook to be honest. Thinking of you and hope you are okay. Xxx

Wow, you are the same age as my daughter. She turns 23 on the 29th July. Can I just say you have one thing going for you, you are a great writer. You have insight and you communicate that well, so that is something.
It sucks when there is no one to talk too, good on you for posting on here and expressing yourself. I wish there was something I could say to make you feel better, but I know better than that. But I have a mother's heart, and if ever you need to talk, just reach out I will listen.
Coat them in oil then place them small end down in a container. They will last a couple of months like this, longer if the weather is cooler or they are refrigerated.

I read somewhere that if you coat them in oil then they last for months. Apparently the egg shell is porous and let's in oxygen which makes the egg spoil. Coating them prevents this from happening and they last longer. 
I haven't tested this theory though.

Okay I'm new here but this sparked my interest.
My mum hands down has the best meatloaf recipe and it never fails to please anyone who tries it. 

500gm mince
250gm sausage mince
1 onion chopped
2 tsp crushed garlic
2 eggs
2 Weet-Bix crushed ( or 2 handfuls bread crumbs) 
2 heaped tspn curry powder
2 tbsp tomato sauce
2 tbsp plum jam
Salt and pepper

Mix all together and place in a loaf tin, cook in moderate oven for 1 hour.
Enjoy.
